original.plateauProof: On correction support X<=Xb, r<=Rstar*sqrt(tau0), where tau0=2^(-(ellMinimum+15)) and ellMinimum>=Rstar^1024. Set u=log Rstar>=0. Then log(2)*(Rstar^1024+15)> (16+1024*u)/2>2*u+log(4), so r<1/2=r0/2.

firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.cutoff: T=C(r,z,tau)*chi(a1*q(z,tau)); a1 is the original fixed scalar.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.gradient: g=(T_r,0,T_z). On the pinned radial plateau T_r=0.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.velocity: v_n=T*u_n+g cross A_n; on the radial plateau g=T_z*e_z.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.gradientColumns: (D_k v)_n=T*(D_k u)_n+(D_k T)*u_n+(D_k g) cross A_n+g cross (D_k A)_n.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.cylindricalAngleColumn: D_theta v_n=(i*n*v_n+e_z cross v_n)/r; D_theta g=(0,T_r/r,0).
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.forceCutoffDerivatives: In ordinary directions r,z use the full twice differentiated product rule for T*u and grad(T) cross A; in tau use the corresponding once differentiated product. The cutoff uses up to order three in space and order (one space, one time).
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.zeroAndNonzero: C and chi carry frequency zero. Mean–wave cross vanishes. Sum equal signed carrier contributions before any squared norm.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.energyDissipation: Normalized Haar yields the sum of squared v_n and covariant gradient columns at each r,z,tau. For real fields, positive frequency squared terms have multiplicity two.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.scalarMeasure: Original volume density is independent of theta. Integration of the circle quantities against it needs radial, axial and temporal interval inputs.
firstCorrectionPhysicalCoefficients.discreteAliasing: An N-node circle agrees for the quadratic scalar if N does not divide any nonzero frequency difference in the operand support. N>2*max|n| suffices in the cylindrical pairing.
